svg.desc: 6 resources (3 spatial cards, 3 logical resources in 2 group cards) · 5 relationships Thin solid: dependency. Dashed: association. Thick dotted: connection. Nested boxes: containment. Edge color preserves the Terraform action when available. Service label backgrounds: orange = compute; green = storage; blue = network; red = IAM; gray = unclassified. Spatial card role marks: rounded rectangle = execution; cylinder = data store; hexagon = network.
